verdict.rationale: Keycloak is a standards-based OIDC/OAuth 2.0 server. Its docs cover a discovery endpoint (/.well-known/openid-configuration), OIDC client registration with redirect URIs, introspection and revocation endpoints that handle refresh tokens, plus client-credentials and device grants. Community users report wiring many apps (Grafana, ASP.NET, VueJS) through its OIDC interface rather than hand-rolling protocol logic. missing for 10: explicit documentation of authorization code with PKCE, first-party client libraries/adapters that hide protocol details from the developer, and independent hands-on corroboration of the refresh-token flow specifically (community notes steep OAuth/OIDC knowledge requirements and weak docs).
